svg.title: 4K Omarchy frame achieved; QEMU SDL host GPU relay verified; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 gates
svg.desc: Actual NVIDIA-rendered 3840 by 2160 Omarchy wallpaper, bar and readable application are verified. Two guest runs pass 300 GPU handoffs with application resizing and input response. Separate paused disk-free QEMU SDL host controls now verify cross-process GPU import and BGRA compute conversion, including 300 handoffs and complete first/last backbuffers. Real guest compositor connection to this SDL relay remains next. Official input source is retained. Four backend stages are demonstrated, two are in progress and two await acceptance. Three desktop product gates are in progress and none is complete. Physical input, normal launcher integration, multi-window reliability and matched-native performance remain open. These checklist counts do not measure engineering effort. Updated October 21, 2026.

g.text: First Hyprland frame achieved · Complete GPU backbuffer: 3840×2160
Guest desktop: two 300-frame GPU resize + input-response runs pass
QEMU SDL host control: 4K GPU import + BGRA conversion verified
Next: real guest compositor through this SDL relay, with official input retained
Green: demonstrated · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-21
Desktop diagnostic client: 1280×720 · SDL host backbuffer: 3840×2160 · Physical 4K scanout unverified
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
